item.title: [DIS] Mobile-Ready CKB Light Client (Pocket Node) for Android (1 posts)
item.description: Pocket Node v1.8.5 is out This release makes the app lock smarter, keeps every wallet syncing when you change sync settings, improves Nervos DAO unlocks, and cleans up a few confusing activity entries. Unlock returns you where you were. Coming back to the app no longer drops you on Home. A half-typed send or an open transaction is still there after you unlock. Secrets are cleared when the app locks. A recovery phrase or private key on screen, or being typed, is wiped on every lock. Restored wallets sync their recent history. Imports now start from Recent (about the last 30 days), and you choose the sync start point after every import. All your wallets keep syncing. Changing one wallet’s...

item.description: Update: v1.2 is live on testnet, and the project is now CrowdCell It’s been a while since the last update here, so here’s where things are. item.title: Post-quantum ownership on CKB without changing your contract: notes from Cells (2 posts)
item.description: Any CKB contract that authorises an owner by lock hash, and accepts any lock there, can have post-quantum owners today with no contract change. The stored owner only has to be the hash of a lock under Nervos’s quantum-resistant lock script, which verifies SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+, NIST FIPS 205) signatures. We build Cells, a naming protocol on CKB, and did this there: .cell names on mainnet can be owned this way since September 2026. item.title: Spark Program | LiquidLane: Fiber Receive Capacity Marketplace | RESUBMISSION (1 posts)
